fee_notes: Supercuts uses a Development Fee structure in lieu of a separate Initial Franchise Fee for new franchisees (those signing after September 29, 2011). The Development Fee serves as full payment for development and franchise rights: $39,500 for a Single Salon, $69,500 for 3-Salon Fast Start, $99,500 for 6-Salon Fast Start, plus $10,000 for each additional Salon beyond 6. There is no separate Initial Franchise Fee charged under the Franchise Agreement for these new franchisees. Existing franchisees who signed before September 30, 2011 pay lower Development Fees ($10,000–$12,500 per Salon) and $0 Initial Franchise Fee. During the last fiscal year, Development Fees ranged from $0 to $39,500, reflecting possible waivers or reductions in unique situations.
raw_excerpt: Supercuts' current practice is to sign a Development Agreement with all franchisees for each new franchise acquisition, even if the franchisee expects to develop only one Salon. ... If you are a new franchisee or an existing franchisee that signed a Development Agreement after September 29, 2011 , the Development Fee is full payment for your development and franchise rights, whether for one Salon, or more than one Salon. If you are such a "new" franchisee, Supercuts does not charge you any initial franchise fees for Salons to be developed under the Development Agreement. There is no separate Initial Franchise Fee due under the Franchise Agreement. ... During last fiscal year, our Development Fees ranged $0 to $39,500.
